verdict.rationale: Gmail's built-in Gemini assistant takes delegated tasks inside the product: it summarizes threads, drafts and refines emails, organizes mail on request (deleting multiple emails, adding labels), and proposes meeting times from Calendar. Community users confirm the AI features exist and are used day to day, though one reported a hallucinated summary and another noted Smart Features must be opted into. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the assistant's agentic scope and limits beyond brief feature bullets, and evidence of reliability, given a reported hallucinated summary.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Organize: Ask Gemini to do things like delete multiple emails or add labels.
Summarize: Synthesize long email threads into concise bullet points. Draft: Create new emails or refine existing drafts for tone and clarity.
Schedule: Propose meeting times based on your availability in Google Calendar.
Gemini in Gmail saves you time drafting or polishing emails, and suggested replies help you reply in one click, in your voice.
